property_summary: After initialize with an ERC20 base token of d decimals (d<18), price() must use exponent 36-d (per _baseToken); the mutant stores address(0) and uses exponent 18, so price() differs for any reserves with d<18.
change_summary: Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken always ends up as address(0).
